# hyperfluid_alert_channel (Data Source)

Look up an alert channel by name. The webhook URL is only returned masked. Needs the organization's `alerting_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_alert_channel" "ops" {
  name = "ops-mail"
}

output "ops_channel_id" {
  value = data.hyperfluid_alert_channel.ops.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Channel name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether alerts are delivered.
- `id` (String) Channel id.
- `kind` (String) `email`, `slack_webhook` or `discord_webhook`.
- `recipients` (Set of String) Email addresses of an email channel.
- `url_masked` (String) The webhook URL, truncated by the platform.
